context: Two players debrief after a hard-fought match
purpose: Teach: 山田/低く/背中/ラスト/コート/ヒント/店長/争い

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いやー、今日の試合は本当に苦しかったな。コートに立った瞬間から空気が違った。
lines.en: Man, today's match was really tough. The air felt different the moment we stepped onto the court.
lines.style: Tired exhale, voice still warm from adrenaline, half-laughing through the exhaustion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ですよね。特に山田さん、構えがめちゃくちゃ低くて、あれ全然読めなかったっす。
lines.en: Right? Especially Yamada-san — his stance was so low, I couldn't read it at all.
lines.style: Younger, slightly fanboyish, animated and a little breathless, casual sports register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、腰を低く落として打つタイプだろ。あれ、背中の使い方にヒントがあるって監督が言ってた。
lines.en: Yeah, he's the type who drops his hips low to hit. Coach said the secret is in how he uses his back.
lines.style: Thoughtful, analytical mentor tone, sharing insight calmly while catching his breath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 背中ですか。なるほど…俺、ラストの三ゲーム、完全に体力切れてました。
lines.en: His back, huh. I see... For the last three games, I was completely out of stamina.
lines.style: Genuine realization, slightly self-deprecating, voice dropping with honest reflection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まあ、優勝争いに残ってるだけで十分すごいよ。来週も同じコートで決勝だぞ。
lines.en: Hey, just staying in the championship race is impressive. The final is on the same court next week.
lines.style: Encouraging senpai voice, warm and steady, giving a clap on the shoulder feeling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うっす。あ、そういえば帰りに店長が差し入れ持って待ってるって。
lines.en: Yes sir. Oh by the way, the shop manager said he's waiting with snacks for us on the way home.
lines.style: Brightening up suddenly, casual teen energy, the mood shifting toward food and home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: マジか、あの店長また泣くやつだろ。とりあえずシャワー浴びて行こう。
lines.en: Seriously? That manager is going to cry again, isn't he. Anyway, let's shower first and head over.
lines.style: Amused, affectionate eye-roll, laughing softly, winding down into post-game camaraderie.
